confirmed_findings.rule: Pruning — single source of truth: duplication (the same meaning in more than one place) costs maintenance and tokens and inflates a meaning's prominence past its real rank.
confirmed_findings.target_quote: | Skip query params | Wrong page loads | Full URL, opened in Brave |
confirmed_findings.issue: This anti-pattern row restates the same rule already stated positively in "Critical rules" ("Include FULL URLs with query params (`?project=xyz`) and open them in Brave."). Likewise the row `Vague "click the button" | Which one? | Click "Create credentials"` restates "Use EXACT element text (copy from the current UI)." The two lists encode the same meanings in two places with no single authoritative source, so a future rule change requires editing both.
confirmed_findings.proposed_fix: Keep the rule stated once. Either drop the "Skip query params" and "Vague 'click the button'" rows from Anti-patterns (leaving only anti-patterns not already covered by Critical rules, e.g. "Playwright/xvfb for OAuth consent" and "Assume Will knows the IDs"), or drop the corresponding Critical rules bullets and let the Anti-patterns table be the sole source.
confirmed_findings.reason: CONFIRMED: The quoted row appears verbatim in the Anti-patterns table, and it does restate the same guidance already given in "Critical rules" ("Include FULL URLs with query params... opened in Brave"), a genuine duplication of meaning across two lists.

confirmed_findings.rule: Steps and completion criteria — Clarity: a vague bound invites premature completion; the criterion should let the agent tell done from not-done.
confirmed_findings.issue: The step names the action (re-read the config) but not the success condition — it doesn't state what "verified" means (e.g. the stored value matches the value Will reported). An agent can perform the re-read and consider the step complete without ever checking the result against anything, which is exactly the premature-completion failure the doctrine warns about for vague bounds.
confirmed_findings.proposed_fix: 6. Verify — re-read the config via API and confirm the stored value matches what Will reported.
confirmed_findings.reason: CONFIRMED: The quoted text appears verbatim in the workflow list, and the criticism is valid—"Verify (re-read the config via API)" specifies the action but not the success condition, matching the cited clarity rule about vague bounds inviting premature completion.
